title: Component Spec: Button
summary:
A single-purpose action trigger that renders a labelled button and fires an
`onClick` event when the user activates it. Supports disabled and loading
states.

responsibilities.heading: 3.1 MUST
items: Render a labelled, accessible button element.
Fire onClick when the user clicks or presses Enter/Space.
Apply the disabled visual when disabled is true and suppress onClick.

responsibilities.heading: 3.2 SHOULD
items: Show a spinner in place of the label when loading is true.
Forward a ref to the underlying <button> element.

responsibilities.heading: 3.3 MUST NOT
items: Manage navigation or side-effects; those belong in the caller.
Override browser focus styles without providing an accessible alternative.

inputs.Description: Visible button text or accessible label.
Prevents interaction and applies disabled styling.
Replaces label with a spinner; implies disabled.

outputs.Description: Signals user intent to activate the button.
outputs.Emitted When: User clicks or presses Enter/Space on a non-disabled button.

visualStates.heading: 8.1 Default
items: Description: Normal interactive state; no interaction in progress.
Visuals: Filled primary background, white label, full opacity.

visualStates.heading: 8.2 Hover
items: Description: Pointer is over the button.
Visuals: Background lightens by 10%; cursor changes to pointer.

visualStates.heading: 8.3 Focused
items: Visuals: 2px offset focus ring matches the brand accent colour.

visualStates.heading: 8.4 Disabled
items: Description: disabled or loading is true.
Visuals: 40% opacity; cursor changes to not-allowed; onClick is suppressed.

visualStates.heading: 8.5 Loading
items: Description: loading is true; action is in progress.
Visuals: Label replaced by a spinner; button is disabled while in this state.
